name: agent-cli
description: Project: Agent CLI Repo: yysun/agent-cli CLI: agent-cli Core objects: - Memory = map marks - Tension = terrain signals - Insight = route judgment - Action = next move

scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test:syntax: node --check ./bin/agent-cli.js && node --check ./server/bin/relay-server.js && node --check ./lib/agent-config.js && node --check ./lib/paths.js && node --check ./lib/agent-files.js && node --check ./lib/session-store.js && node --check ./lib/runtime-client.js && node --check ./lib/relay-client.js && node --check ./server/lib/relay-server.js && node --check ./lib/remote-control.js && node --check ./vitest.config.js && node --check ./tests/helpers/test-root.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-cli.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-config.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-files.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/paths.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/session-store.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/runtime-client.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/relay-server.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/remote-control.test.js && node --check ./tests/e2e/agent-cli.e2e.test.js && node --check ./tests/e2e/relay-server.e2e.test.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n RELAY,WEB,CLI "npm run dev:relay" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:cli"
scripts.dev:relay:lan: npm run web:build && npm run relay-server:lan --
scripts.dev:web: npm run dev:wait-relay && npm run web:dev
scripts.relay-server:prod: npm run web:build && npm run relay-server:lan --
